mentions.name: Airflow news collection pipeline
mentions.description: This project is an Airflow pipeline focused on collecting news, built partly for the author's own use and partly as a learning platform. News processing is initially done with a stronger LLM and results saved, with the eventual goal of attempting to train a small language model (SLM) on those results.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building my an airflow pipeline focused on collecting news.

Partly because I want one, but also because it makes for a good learning platform. e.g. initially do some of the processing with a stronger llm...save result and then attempt to train a SLM or similar
